baseline_loading: Execute the exact baseline chapter and section method AST plus its _integer and _string validators; no algorithm substitutions.
candidate_identity: Record Git HEAD, source status, store.py SHA-256, harness SHA-256, protocol SHA-256, and workflow run identity.

fixture.source: Deterministic single-turn Unicode conversations ingested with adaptive segmentation and max_page_chars=128; 130 evidence paragraphs per session, one section per session.
fixture.required_pages_per_target_section: More than 100; record actual minimum and maximum.
fixture.timestamps: Explicit source timestamps; incidental creation/update timestamps fixed before freezing.
fixture.storage: One temporary on-disk WAL archive; exact row digest and table counts recorded.
fixture.timed_connections: Both arms share one query-only connection to the frozen archive. A separate query-only connection performs instrumentation.

configurations.combination: All nine pairs; exact project scope and first directory page.

contract_audits.equality: Exact dictionary/list payload and emitted JSON insertion order, before timing and after every timed call.
contract_audits.selects: Untimed SQLite trace records every statement and SELECT count.
contract_audits.materialization: Untimed length(content) instrumentation must equal returned previews; each arm reports all counts and output SHA-256.
contract_audits.transaction_cleanup: No open transaction may remain after a call; measurement connections must report zero writes.
contract_audits.tests: tests.test_directory_batches covers golden equality, max bounds, indexes, scope, custom section overrides, caller transactions, failure cleanup, and concurrent WAL delete/reingest.

timing.secondary: time.process_time_ns process CPU per call; scheduler diagnostic, never a substitute for wall latency
timing.excluded: Fixture creation, tracing, materialization instrumentation, equality checks, output hashing, report writes, and explicit result disposal.
timing.cache_state: Warm after audit and warmups; no claim about cold startup or cold operating-system page cache.

reporting.raw_observations: Append, flush and fsync one JSONL event after every timed call; record errors and output equality as well as timings.
reporting.checkpoints: Atomically save partial JSON after audits, each completed arm/round, and on failure. Existing report/event outputs are not overwritten by a new run.
reporting.summary: Per-arm medians, all four paired candidate/baseline median ratios, and their median, separately for wall and process CPU.
reporting.failure: Preserve completed and partial observations, write a failed status and exception, and return nonzero; never substitute a successful report.
reporting.interpretation: Component-only evidence on the frozen fixture; no recall-quality or end-to-end speedup claim.
